summary.text: John Winchester is the Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Tucsonan, husband and father of four who works in government relations, and said he would emphasize school choice, public safety and lower housing and energy costs.

paragraphs.text: Winchester's Ballotpedia profile lists a degree from the University of Arizona in 2018 and one from Arizona State University in 2025.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he would support law enforcement and first responders and listed energy and land policy, public safety and education among the policy areas he cares about most.
He listed endorsements from the Greater Phoenix Chamber of Commerce, the Arizona Association of Realtors and the Tucson Police Officers Association.
